import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long pow(long a, long p) {
        long res = 1;
        while (p > 0) {
            if (p % 2 == 1) {
                res = (res * a) % MOD;
            }
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            p /= 2;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        sc.close();

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(pow(p, p - 1));
            return;
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(pow(p, p));
            return;
        }
        long order = 1;
        long a = k;
        while (a != 1) {
            a = (a * k) % p;
            order++;
        }
        System.out.println(pow(p, (p - 1) / order));
    }
}
